import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from plan_graph import build_arcs,fill_circulation
from ns2 import NetworkSimplex
from fractions import Fraction
random.seed(5)
S=256;J=512;F=16;G=4
slots=[]
for s in range(S): slots.append([s,10,0 if s==0 else 10])
flows=[[1,8,0,random.randrange(7)] for f in range(F)]
groups=[[-1,512],[0,512],[0,512],[1,100]]
wins=[]
for j in range(J):
    f=random.randrange(F)
    wins.append([f,0,S-1,random.randint(1,65535),random.randint(1,320),0,random.randint(1,1000),[[0,0]]*9])
case={'model':'cnn','class_values':[random.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[1,1,75],'bucket':[512,0],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':wins}
preds=[random.randrange(7) for _ in wins];th=[65535]*J;r=Fraction(0)
K,R,Z,a,b,e,w,z,h,arcs=build_arcs(case,preds,th,r)
E=len(arcs);print('K,E',K,E)
f0=[l for u,v,l,h,c in arcs]
t=time.time();f1=fill_circulation(case,preds,th,r,f0);print('fill',time.time()-t,'ZR',f1[-1])
# special builder
elig=[]; mat=[[-1]*S for _ in range(J)]; elig_slot=[-1]*E; elig_win=[-1]*E;zero=[]
enodes=list(e);wnodes=list(w);eset=set(e);wset=set(w)
for i,(u,v,l,hh,c) in enumerate(arcs):
    if c!=0:
        j=v-2-3*S;ss=(u-4)//3
        elig.append((i,ss,j));mat[j][ss]=i;elig_slot[i]=ss;elig_win[i]=j
    else:zero.append(i)
wr=[(0,S-1)]*J
W=1+J*slots[-1][0]
win_base=[-wins[j][1]-wins[j][6]*case['class_values'][preds[j]]*W for j in range(J)]
special={'elig':elig,'elig_matrix':mat,'win_ranges':wr,'wnodes':wnodes,'enodes':enodes,'win_base':win_base,'slot_times':[x[0] for x in slots],'S':S,'zero_eids':zero,'elig_slot':elig_slot,'elig_win':elig_win}
t=time.time();ns=NetworkSimplex(K,arcs,f1);print('init',time.time()-t)
t=time.time();ns.solve(verbose=True,special=special);print('solve',time.time()-t,'iters',ns.iters,'degen',ns.degenerate,'obj',ns.objective())
# verify
pi=ns.potentials();bad=0
for i in range(ns.E):
 rc=ns.cost[i]+pi[ns.fr[i]]-pi[ns.to[i]]
 if ns.flow[i]<ns.hi[i] and rc<0:bad+=1
 if ns.flow[i]>ns.lo[i] and -rc<0:bad+=1
print('bad',bad,'positive elig',sum(1 for eid,ss,jj in elig if ns.flow[eid]>0))
